ios_update.description: Problems with updating iOS, unavailable updates, failed updates, or bugs that appear after an iOS update.

battery_power.description: Battery draining quickly, charging problems, unexpected shutdowns, or power-related issues.

app_issue.description: Applications crashing, freezing, failing to open, loading incorrectly, or behaving unexpectedly.

device_performance.description: General iPhone, iPad, or Mac performance problems such as freezing, touchscreen issues, random behavior, or system instability.

audio_call_issue.description: Problems with phone calls, microphones, speakers, audio playback, static, or inability to hear another person.

connectivity.description: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, wireless connection, or accessory connectivity problems.

apple_id_account.description: Apple ID, account access, authentication, login, or account-related problems.

app_store_purchase.description: App Store issues, purchases, payment/store credit problems, or downloading applications.

music_media.description: Apple Music, iTunes, iBooks, media syncing, music playback, or media-library problems.

feature_how_to.description: Questions about using Apple features, settings, controls, or how to perform an action.

service_support.description: Requests for Apple support, service appointments, callbacks, contacting support, or escalation to a support representative.

other_unclear.description: Messages that do not contain enough information to identify a supported intent, including contextual follow-ups and ambiguous messages.
